title: Test the vessel_owner_cap config clamp
message:
Test the vessel_owner_cap config clamp

The coverage gate found the new vessel_owner_cap parse in
load_config_stream() executed by no test. Parse it in a child, since the
loader resets every option, and check a value in range, both clamps, and
the default when the tag is absent.

title: Make the Phase 18 schema apply to a fresh database
message:
Make the Phase 18 schema apply to a fresh database

CI applies each component schema to a fresh master_schema.sql, which has
no ship_prototypes (Phase 04), vessel_bounties (Phase 07), or
ship_interiors.wages_owed (Phase 06), so vessels_phase18_schema.sql failed
at its first ALTER. It now creates them as the server's boot DDL does
before altering and updating them, and is still a no-op on a database
that already has them.

title: Compare the hull owner's name explicitly in the fire check
message:
Compare the hull owner's name explicitly in the fire check

clang-tidy's bugprone-suspicious-string-compare gate flagged the bare
str_cmp() result in vessel_fire_permitted().

title: Record the rules gate rerun without a temporary path
message:
Record the rules gate rerun without a temporary path

The validation record named a per-session temporary directory that no
reviewer can inspect once the host is cleaned. Keep the command, source
revision, installed binary hash, and result instead, from the rerun on
the review fixes, and note the second full test pass.

title: Delete only the rules gate's own shipyard prototype
message:
Delete only the rules gate's own shipyard prototype

The rules acceptance cleanup deleted every unreferenced ship_prototypes
row named Rulesraft%, so a builder's unused prototype with a matching name
would be lost. The session now reports the ID of the prototype it creates,
and cleanup deletes only that ID, and only if no runtime hull uses it. The
final check looks for that ID instead of the name.

title: Read hull levels without DDL and fail closed
message:
Read hull levels without DDL and fail closed

vessel_ship_min_level() ran vessel_prototype_ensure_schema() on every
setsail, autopilot on, assignpilot, and setschedule, so each departure
issued CREATE TABLE and ALTER TABLE on the game loop, where the ALTER can
wait on another transaction's metadata lock. shipbrowse, shipbuy, and
vedit ran the same DDL. The schema is migrated at boot; command paths now
only check that the database is reachable and read.

When a prototype-backed hull's level could not be read, the check fell
back to the class minimum, so a raft configured for level 30 sailed for
a level-1 captain during a database failure. An unreadable level now
refuses the departure for mortals.

title: Record vessel fire grace for the gunner only
message:
Record vessel fire grace for the gunner only

vessel_fire_permitted() called vessel_pvp_permitted() for the gunner and
again for the hull owner, and each call recorded logout grace. A shot the
hull owner then refused still left grace on both hulls, and an approved
shot by a permit holder overwrote the target's grace attacker with the
owner, so the gunner lost it when the target's owner logged out.

Both consent checks now go through a side-effect-free helper, and one
engagement is recorded for the actual gunner only once the shot is
permitted. shipfire checks consent after range and arc, so a shot that
never fires records nothing. With the target's owner gone, the hull
owner need only still have PvP enabled, so the gunner can use the grace
they earned.

title: Document the vessel rules gate and close out study step S1
message:

title: Add a live gate for the vessel rules fixes
message:
Add a live gate for the vessel rules fixes

test_vessel_rules_in_game.sh runs the tactical harness in a new --rules
mode: Kohdee and Vesselmate check the for-sale shipyard listing and its
level column, contact IDs shared by contacts, tactical, and shipfire, the
passenger gunnery refusal, the hull level on a deeded warship, the
three-hull cap, and a WANTED bounty's pay-off price. The harness snapshots
and restores both player files and Vesselmate's bounty row.

title: Bind the new shipyard and bounty queries
message:
Bind the new shipyard and bounty queries

The SQL interpolation ratchet rejected the prototype level lookup and the
two new vedit fields as new formatted SQL. They, and the rewritten bounty
read, record, and clear queries, now use bound prepared statements. The
crew, merchant, and piracy baselines shrink with the removed sites.

title: Let vessel bounties decay and be paid off
message:
Let vessel bounties decay and be paid off

Fixes study defect L13 (docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md). Nothing
ever cleared a vessel bounty, so a WANTED captain stayed shut out of lawful
ports and a HUNTED one stayed a hunter target forever.

- vessel_bounties.last_offense_at (Phase 18) starts a decay clock: a bounty
  holds for a day, then loses 5% of its size per day, gone after 21 quiet
  days. Plunder and NPC-merchant consequences share one offense recorder
  that folds in the decay and restarts the clock.
- bounty pay clears the bounty for 125% at any port outside a pirate cove.

title: Gate the shipyard by listing, level, and hull count
message:
Gate the shipyard by listing, level, and hull count

Fixes study defect L11 under decision D5 (docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md).

- Prototypes gain for_sale and min_level (Phase 18 SQL, ensured at boot).
  shipbrowse lists and shipbuy sells only listed hulls; the eight frontier
  class prototypes are listed, NPC, event, and test hulls are not.
- A hull's level (prototype setting or class minimum, 1 to 25) gates
  setsail out of a port, autopilot on, assignpilot, and setschedule.
- One player owns at most three hulls (cedit Vessel Hulls Per Owner,
  1-10), enforced at shipbuy, claimship, and shipdeed.
- Phase 18 also clears wage debt left by the retired payroll.

title: Make vessel crew a one-time hire
message:
Make vessel crew a one-time hire

Fixes study defect L12 under decision D4 (docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md).
Crew no longer accrue wages every 300 seconds, including while the owner is
offline, and no longer walk off over unpaid paydays. shipwages is retired.
Hire prices move to the study's one-time table (3.3.5). The retired
wages_owed and wage_ticks columns stay in the schema, unread.

title: Gate vessel gunnery and share one contact list
message:
Gate vessel gunnery and share one contact list

Fixes study defects L4, L5, L7, L8 and L9 (docs/ongoing-projects/vessels-ships.md).

- Manual sailing reads the storm band from vessel_storm_severity() instead of
  treating raw weather above 50 of 255 as a storm.
- Only the owner, helm permit holders, members of the online owner's group,
  and staff may fire a hull's weapons; a non-owner firing on another player's
  hull also needs the hull owner's consent.
- Every shot costs command lag, hit or miss.
- contacts, tactical, and shipfire share vessel_collect_contacts(): vessels
  within sight range, nearest first, shown and targeted by two-letter ID.
- Hulls in a port neither fire nor take player or NPC fire.
